title: GOTO identification and broad-band modelling of the counterpart to the SVOM GRB 250818B
question: What are the physical parameters of the broadband afterglow, circumburst environment, and host-galaxy association of the SVOM-triggered GRB 250818B?

what.value: Optical and radio follow-up measurements reported in GCN Circulars (SVOM/VT, Swift/UVOT, KAIT, NOT, SAO RAS, TRT, Lesedi, LT, GRANDMA/KNC, FTW, VLA 10 GHz)

evidence.quote: and by numerous ground-based facilities including KAIT (cite: Zheng2025gcn41417), NOT (cite: BroeBendtsen2025gcn41426), SAO RAS (cite: Moskvitin2025gcn41428), TRT (cite: An2025gcn41430), Lesedi (cite: Kumar2025gcnLesedi), LT (cite: Dimple2025gcn41442), the GRANDMA/Kilonova-Catcher network (cite: Hellot2025gcn41444), and the Wendelstein FTW telescope (cite: Busmann2025gcn41445)
In addition, we include the 10 GHz flux density reported in GCN 41455 (cite: Ricci2025gcn41455).

what.value: Optical R-band GRB afterglow comparison samples

evidence.quote: To place the optical afterglow of GRB 250818B in the broader GRB population, we compare its observer-frame $R$-band evolution with the literature compilation of (cite: Kann2006; Kann2010; Kann2011) and the sGRB sample of (cite: NicuesaGuelbenzu2012).

evidence.quote: To further constrain the redshift of the probable host galaxy, we compare its photometry to the galaxy population in the COSMOS-Web DR1 catalogue (cite: 2026A&A...704A.339S).

recipe.goal: Measure radio and millimetre flux densities and upper limits (including ALMA and MeerKAT)
recipe.method: Download ALMA QA2 archive images and inspect a 0.5 arcsec circle at the GOTO position to measure local image rms and 3-sigma upper limits; measure MeerKAT flux density and rms at the GOTO position using pwkit/imtool on SARAO pipeline images.
key_parameters: 0.5 arcsec radius inspection circle at GOTO position for ALMA

recipe.goal: Reduce Keck/LRIS optical spectrum and determine redshift
recipe.method: Reduce and co-add exposures using PypeIt (bias subtraction, flat-fielding, cosmic ray masking, wavelength calibration, 1D extraction, flux calibration, telluric correction), correct for Milky Way extinction, and align metal absorption lines (Fe II, Mg II, Mg I) to measure redshift.
assumptions: E(B-V)_MW = 0.0633 mag and R_V = 3.1 Milky Way extinction law

recipe.method: Download and bin Swift/XRT data into S/N = 10 intervals via SWIFTTOOLS API and simultaneously fit absorbed power-law models (TBABS*ZTBABS*CFLUX*POWERLAW) across three intervals.
assumptions: Wilms solar abundance, fixed N_H,Gal = 6.49e20 cm^-2, fixed z = 1.216

recipe.goal: Fit single-epoch optical SED for line-of-sight host extinction
recipe.method: Subtract late-time DECam host flux from LT gri photometry at t_ref = 2.035 d and fit a dust-extinguished power-law model for MW and SMC extinction laws.
key_parameters: t_ref = 2.035 d, 5% fractional systematic flux uncertainty added
assumptions: Milky Way law with R_V = 3.1 and SMC Bar law with R_V = 2.74; z = 1.216

recipe.goal: Model broadband afterglow and compare jet/energy-injection models
recipe.method: Fit broadband X-ray, optical/NIR, and radio detections and upper limits with a baseline top-hat jet model (afterglowpy) and a refreshed-shock two-component jet model (twocomponent_redback_refreshed in redback).
key_parameters: For twocomponent_refreshed: fixed theta_obs = 0, log epsilon_e = -1, log epsilon_B = -2, xi_N = 1
assumptions: Constant-density circumburst medium (n_0), z = 1.216, flat LambdaCDM cosmology (H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7)

recipe.goal: Evaluate host-galaxy association and model candidate host SED
recipe.method: Compute Bayesian host association probabilities and empirical chance-coincidence probabilities (P_cc) for LS DR10 candidates within 0.1 deg, estimate local depth limits for an undetected coincident host, match photometry to COSMOS-Web DR1, and fit the candidate host SED with Prospector.
key_parameters: 0.1 deg search radius in LS DR10; delayed-tau SFH in Prospector
assumptions: Chabrier IMF, Calzetti foreground dust law, fixed z = 1.216 for Prospector fit
